author: Chase Davis
title: Tanner Scott slams door on Yankees for save
desc: Tanner Scott struck out one batter in a scoreless appearance to earn the save in Friday's 2-1 win over the Yankees.
impact: After Friday's win, Scott now has a 2.50 ERA and 0.76 WHIP with 14 saves, two blown saves and six holds across 42 appearances. He's had three straight perfect appearances after giving up three runs to the Rockies on July 6.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Royce Lewis (hamstring) not in lineup Saturday
desc: Royce Lewis is not in the Twins lineup on Saturday due to left hamstring soreness.
impact: Twins manager Derek Shelton said Lewis reported to park feeling better. He is day-to-day.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Wilber Dotel to be 27th man in doubleheader Saturday
desc: Wilber Dotel will be the 27th man for the Pirates in Saturday's doubleheader against the Guardians.
impact: Dotel's rehab assignment is over. It is unclear if he'll remain in the majors after Saturday.

author: Chase Davis
title: Roki Sasaki earns no decision in 2-1 win over Yankees
desc: Roki Sasaki allowed one run, zero earned, on five hits and one walk while striking out five over 5.2 innings Friday against the Yankees.
impact: Sasaki allowed seven hard hits while picking up 16 whiffs on 94 pitches. After the outing, he now has a 4.98 ERA and 1.34 WHIP with a 3-5 record through 17 starts. His next start will come against the Mets on the road.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Oneil Cruz (hand) transferred to 60-day IL
desc: The Pirates transferred Oneil Cruz to the 60-day injured list.
impact: The move opens up a spot on the Pirates 40-man roster. Cruz will be eligible to be activated on August 7.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Khristian Curtis has contract selected by Pirates
desc: The Pirates selected the contract of RHP Khristian Curtis from Triple-A Indianapolis.
impact: Curtis will add an extra arm for Pittsburgh in Saturday's doubleheader.

author: Chase Davis
title: Masyn Winn cashes in thrice in tight 5-4 win
desc: Masyn Winn went 1-for-2 in a win over the Diamondbacks with a walk and three RBI.
impact: After Friday's win over Arizona, Winn is batting .245 with four home runs, seven stolen bases, 41 RBI, 39 runs scored, a .291 wOBA across 88 games. He has nine RBI in his 14 July games.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Rudy Martin traded to Orioles
desc: The Royals traded Rudy Martin to the Orioles for cash considerations.
impact: Martin will add outfield depth in the Orioles organization.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Rob Refsnyder (knee) to start rehab assignment Saturday
desc: Rob Refsnyder will begin a rehab assignment with Triple-A Tacoma on Saturday.
impact: Refsnyder could be activated at some point next week after playing in a handful of rehab games.

author: Chase Davis
title: JJ Wetherholt clubs homer in win over Dbacks
desc: JJ Wetherholt went 2-for-4 in a 5-4 win over the Diamondbacks with a home run, a walk, one run scored and one RBI.
impact: After Friday's win, Wetherholt is slashing .262/.359/.408 with 14 home runs, 37 RBI, 59 runs scored and nine stolen bases across 91 games. He's second to Kevin McGonigle in rookie fWAR.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Matt Brash (lat) starts throwing program
desc: Matt Brash has started a throwing program.
impact: Brash continues to slowly work his way back from a lat injury. He is targeting a return in mid-to-late August.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Parks Harber promoted to Triple-A
desc: The Giants promoted Parks Harber to Triple-A Sacramento.
impact: Harber is the No. 13 prospect for San Francisco per MLB Pipeline. He is one step away from reaching the majors.

author: Chase Davis
title: Luis Gastelum coughs up late lead, nabs win
desc: Luis Gastelum allowed two earned runs on one hit and one walk while striking out one batter and taking a blown save in Friday's 5-4 win over the Diamondbacks.
impact: Gastelum earned the win after the Cardinals took back the lead in the ninth inning. He's allowed a run in three of his four big league appearances.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Trevor Cohen promoted to Double-A
desc: The Giants promoted Trevor Cohen from High-A Eugene to Double-A Richmond.
impact: Cohen was a third-round pick for San Francisco in 2025. His speed has been on full display, stealing 26 bases on the season.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Gavin Kilen promoted to Double-A
desc: The Giants promoted Gavin Kilen from High-A Eugene to Double-A Richmond.
impact: Kilen was the first-round pick for San Francisco in 2025. He is hitting .283 on the season with nine home runs and 65 RBI.
